headers._comment: Report-Only first. The site uses inline Astro scripts and inline styles, Google Fonts, a YouTube embed and a Web3Forms POST, so a blocking policy would break it if any origin were missed. Watch the browser console for violations, then rename this key to Content-Security-Policy to enforce.
headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://va.vercel-scripts.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com data:; img-src 'self' data: blob: https:; media-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' https://api.web3forms.com https://vitals.vercel-insights.com; form-action 'self' https://api.web3forms.com; frame-src https://www.youtube.com https://www.youtube-nocookie.com; frame-ancestors 'self'; base-uri 'self'; object-src 'none'
